claims: Robert Downey Jr. won his first Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor at the 2024 Oscars
The Academy Award was for his role as Lewis Strauss in Oppenheimer
The Oscar nomination for Oppenheimer marked Robert Downey Jr.'s third Oscar nomination
Robert Downey Jr. received previous Oscar nominations for Chaplin in 1993
Robert Downey Jr. received a previous Oscar nomination for Tropic Thunder in 2009
Robert Downey Jr. thanked his wife Susan Downey for her support in his Oscar acceptance speech
Robert Downey Jr. joked in his Oscar acceptance speech that Susan Downey portrayed a sane and rational individual who is happily married to an actor for 22 years
Robert Downey Jr. won the Golden Globe for his performance in Oppenheimer in 2024
Robert Downey Jr. won the BAFTA for his performance in Oppenheimer in 2024
Robert Downey Jr. won the SAG Award for his performance in Oppenheimer in 2024
According to Deadline, Robert Downey Jr. returned to the 98th Oscars stage on March 15, 2026, with Chris Evans to present an award
According to USA Today, during this appearance Robert Downey Jr. joked about his 2024 win
According to USA Today, during this appearance Robert Downey Jr. engaged in a comedic segment with Chris Evans
